tools.name: discord_list_accounts
tools.description: List Discord bot connections linked to this install — id, label, default guild_id.

tools.name: discord_get_me
tools.description: Return the bot's own user profile (id, username, discriminator, avatar, etc).

tools.name: discord_list_guilds
tools.description: List the servers (guilds) the bot is a member of.

tools.name: discord_get_guild
tools.description:
Get one guild's metadata. Falls back to the connection's default guild_id.

Bulk support: accepts guild_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: discord_list_channels
tools.description:
List channels in a guild. Falls back to the connection's default guild_id.

Bulk support: accepts guild_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: discord_list_guild_members
tools.description:
List members of a guild. Requires the bot to have the Server Members intent enabled in the developer portal — may return 403 otherwise.

Bulk support: accepts guild_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: discord_get_channel
tools.description:
Get a channel's metadata (type, name, topic, parent, permissions).

Bulk support: accepts channel_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: discord_list_messages
tools.description:
Read recent messages from a channel (newest first). Pagination via `before` / `after` / `around` (message ids). Requires Message Content intent for non-bot message bodies in some cases.

Bulk support: accepts channel_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: discord_get_message
tools.description:
Fetch a single message by id.

Bulk support: accepts channel_ids, message_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: discord_get_user
tools.description:
Public profile of any Discord user by id.

Bulk support: accepts user_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: discord_send_message
tools.description:
Post a message to a channel. Provide `content` (text up to 2000 chars), `embeds` (rich JSON), or both. `reply_to` makes it a reply.

Bulk support: accepts channel_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: discord_send_dm
tools.description:
Open a DM channel with a user and send them a message. The bot and the user must share a guild.

Bulk support: accepts user_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: discord_edit_message
tools.description:
Edit a previously-sent message (must be authored by this bot).

Bulk support: accepts channel_ids, message_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: discord_add_reaction
tools.description:
Add a reaction to a message. `emoji` is either unicode (e.g. `👍`) or `name:id` for custom guild emoji.

Bulk support: accepts channel_ids, message_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: discord_delete_message
tools.description:
Delete a message. Irreversible. Bot needs Manage Messages to delete messages authored by other users.

Bulk support: accepts channel_ids, message_ids for batched execution.

tools.name: show_version
tools.description: Show the current MCP platform and adapter versions.

tools.name: report_bug
tools.description: Report a bug, missing feature, or send feedback. Include the conversation array with recent messages for reproduction.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Returns connection status and URLs. When all providers are connected, returns authenticated:true and empty pending[]. When credentials are missing, returns connect_url for the toolkit and per-install URLs.

tools.name: toolkit_info
tools.description: Returns the current toolkit state: installed MCPs, their connection status, the accounts connected to each one, and how many catalog tools each exposes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "p_discord" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: discord_list_messages, discord_get_message, discord_send_dm · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: discord_send_message, discord_send_dm, report_bug · Destructive: discord_delete_message, marketplace.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: discord_list_messages, discord_get_message, discord_send_dm · Private data: connect, marketplace, authenticate · Public sink: discord_send_message, discord_send_dm, report_bug · Destructive: discord_delete_message, marketplace

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
